name: Maple Hollow Park
description: A wooded valley park with a spring-fed creek, two picnic shelters and a 6.5 mile loop trail.

name: Fox & Heron Commons
description: A restored wet meadow around the "Big Pond", with a boardwalk and a bird blind on the north shore.

name: Cinder Ridge Overlook
description: Ridge-top prairie with the highest point in the county, a fire tower and 14 miles of gravel trail.

name: Willow Bend Riverside
description: A narrow riverfront strip with a canoe launch, fishing pier and a paved path to downtown.

name: Quarry Lake Park
description: A flooded limestone quarry with a swimming beach, cliff-side trail and summer rentals.
